q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT SALES_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE COM_ID=(SELECT COM_ID FROM COMPANY WHERE NAME='RED') ) SELECT S.NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S LEFT JOIN CTE ON S.SALES_ID=CTE.SALES_ID WHERE CTE.SALES_ID IS NULL
